prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: wide architectural backdrop for the Whale and Dolphin Orchestra interactive website.
Input image: the supplied concert hall photograph is an architectural and material reference, not an edit target.
Primary request: create an original, beautiful modern vineyard concert hall inspired by the reference: visibly sweeping curved balconies and layered seating terraces wrapping around a central stage, honey-coloured timber floors, warm ivory sculpted acoustic walls, charcoal upholstered seats, thousands of tiny warm lights along balcony edges. The architecture should be immediately recognisable as a sophisticated real concert hall interior.
Composition: panoramic landscape, about 2.7:1, viewed from a balcony facing the central stage; full-width sweeping tiers, central stage visible in the lower centre, grand layered ceiling visible above. Symmetrical enough for a website banner, natural photographic perspective. Keep the central stage empty; the interactive ocean map and musicians will be separate real web elements placed around this scene.
Style: highly realistic premium architectural photography, subtle wood grain and acoustic surface texture, luminous warm gold and ivory, restrained shadows and elegant detail.
Constraints: empty hall, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no watermark, no embedded map, no UI controls. This is an imagined architectural visual, not documentation of a named venue.
